HONESTY NOTE (repo-is-truth, verified before authoring this file):
S3RawBlobStore.cs (src/apps/ShramSafal/ShramSafal.Infrastructure/Storage/)
does GetObjectAsync / PutObjectAsync / DeleteObjectAsync entirely server-
side — no presigned URL is ever generated against this bucket anywhere in
src/ (grep for PreSignedUrl / GetPreSignedURL under src/apps found the
DPDP export-bundle presigned URL only, which targets a different,
currently-nonexistent bucket and is opened as a browser navigation, not a
CORS-relevant fetch/XHR). The browser never talks to this bucket directly
today.
This file is authored per §11's explicit instruction as a conservative,
GET-only placeholder for a possible future direct-read path. Applying it
changes nothing observable today — nothing in the app would exercise it.
Given this bucket holds raw, unprocessed voice/receipt evidence rather
than user-facing display assets, think twice before ever widening this
beyond GET, and before making it the delivery path for evidence a farmer
did not explicitly request.
APPLY (founder only): aws s3api put-bucket-cors --bucket agrisync-raw-ap-south-1 --cors-configuration file://cors-policy.json --region ap-south-1
